name: Sakuba Takuya
source:
When he was a child, he was abandoned by his parents and lived in an institution, but was taken in by Yuri and brought to the Sakuba family. Although he knows that he was adopted and that he is not related by blood, he has grown up with Yuri's love and Sakura and Kaede as if they were real siblings, so he has become a bright and honest young man. 

He truly cares about his family, and has a strong sense of wanting to protect the family that has protected him. His hobby is training his body, and he is more muscular than he looks.

Translated from https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/26255
